WITH observatory_shares AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
), above_average AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM observatory_shares
)
SELECT
  SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescope_count,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share;
